product_metadata.title: 6 Pcs Christmas Tartan Plaid and Burlap Poinsettia Picks with Snowed Christmas Tree Ornaments 8.7" Wide for Rustic Vintage Christmas Tree Wreaths Garlands Wreaths Winter Wedding Holiday Decoration
features: Quantity: The package includes 6 pcs Christmas Tartan Plaid and Burlap Poinsettia Picks with Snow, each poinsettia flower comes with a wire stem at the back so you could easily add it wherever you want.

Color: Layering lobed petals join to create a beautiful and unique bloom, crafted of tartan plaid fabric and burlap. Several bunches of stamens protrude from the center, covered with white snow, the petals are dusted with snow, too. The poinsettia situates atop a brown hand wrapped wire stem, you can twist or shape it to meet your needs.

Size: The artificial poinsettia stems are appr. 10.6" tall, measuring from the top of the flower head to the bottom of the stem. Each flower head is appr. 8.7" in diameter, perfect for filling in bare spots of your Christmas tree and bringing you some primitive touch.

Material: The Christmas poinsettia picks are made of cotton tartan plaid fabric and natural burlap, presenting a rustic yuletide style. Flexible stems make them an effortlessly elegant and easy way to be used for various holiday decorating needs.

The Christmas poinsettia picks are perfect to help create a rustic Christmas in your home, they perfectly adorn your Christmas tree, Christmas wreath, Christmas garland, and great for floral arrangement, bouquet, holiday display, festive centerpiece, table arrangement, mantel decor, gift embellishment, Christmas party decor, winter wedding decor, winter bridal shower decor, and so on. Their long-lasting beauty will remain for a long time.
